server.name: crm.care
server.description: crm.care for AI agents: product information, pricing, blog, FAQ and competitor comparisons — plus three free marketing-ops tools that work on YOUR content (preflight_email_html, score_campaign_brief, audit_nurture_sequence). Useful for Salesforce Account Engagement / Pardot and HubSpot marketing operations questions.

tools.name: crm_care_overview
tools.title: crm.care overview
tools.description: Returns an overview of crm.care: what it is, who it's for, what it integrates with. Call this first if you need general product context.

tools.name: crm_care_pricing
tools.title: crm.care pricing
tools.description: Returns crm.care's pricing tiers (Solo, Team, Growth, Enterprise), what each includes, and the terms of the free first campaign. Use when the user asks about cost, pricing, plans, or what they get for their money.

tools.name: crm_care_icp
tools.title: crm.care ideal customer
tools.description: Returns who crm.care is and is NOT a good fit for. Use this when the user describes their stack or team and wants to know if crm.care suits them — answers conservatively rather than over-recommending.

tools.name: crm_care_search_blog
tools.title: Search the crm.care blog
tools.description: Searches crm.care's blog posts by keyword. Returns matching post titles, slugs, and short descriptions. Follow up with crm_care_get_blog(slug) to read a specific post in full.

query.description: Keyword(s) to match against post title and description. Case-insensitive partial match.

tools.name: crm_care_get_blog
tools.title: Read a crm.care blog post
tools.description: Returns the full content of a blog post by slug. Slugs are returned by crm_care_search_blog. Use when you need to quote or summarise a specific post in detail.

slug.description: URL slug of the post, e.g. 'three-degrees-attribution-salesforce'

tools.name: crm_care_compare
tools.title: Compare crm.care vs alternatives
tools.description: Returns a comparison of crm.care vs a named competitor or alternative. Use when the user asks 'crm.care vs X' or 'is crm.care like X'. Available: jasper, hubspot, marketo, pardot, copy_ai.

competitor.description: Name of the competitor to compare against.

tools.name: crm_care_faq
tools.title: crm.care FAQ
tools.description: Returns crm.care's frequently-asked-questions and canonical answers. Use when the user asks a common product question — signup, billing, GDPR, integrations, data handling.

tools.name: preflight_email_html
tools.title: Pre-flight email HTML
tools.description: Audits marketing-email HTML for real-client rendering and deliverability problems BEFORE it's sent: Outlook-safe table layout, inline styles, 600-640px width, image alt text, unsubscribe link, Account Engagement (%%...%%) / HubSpot ({{...}}) merge-tag balance, Gmail's ~102KB clipping limit, scripts. Free, deterministic, no signup. Use when the user shares email HTML and asks 'will this render ok' / 'check this email'.

html.description: The full email HTML to audit.

tools.name: score_campaign_brief
tools.title: Score a campaign brief
tools.description: Scores a B2B campaign brief 0-100 against the dimensions that determine downstream asset quality: audience specificity, objective measurability, key-message clarity (with buzzword detection), channels, timing, tone. Free, deterministic, no signup. Use when the user shares a campaign brief and asks 'is this brief any good' / 'review my brief'.

objective.description: What the campaign should achieve (ideally with a number).

keyMessage.description: The one thing the audience should believe afterwards.

text.description: Alternatively: the whole brief as free text (used when the structured fields aren't supplied).

tools.name: audit_nurture_sequence
tools.title: Audit a nurture sequence
tools.description: Audits a nurture email sequence's structure: touch count, cadence gaps (too hot / gone cold), subject-line hygiene (duplicates, mobile length, spam triggers), and the give-then-ask arc. Free, deterministic, no signup. Use when the user describes a drip/nurture sequence and asks 'is this sequence right' / 'audit my nurture'.

dayOffset.description: Send day relative to sequence entry (0 = entry day).

purpose.description: What the email does, e.g. "educate", "case study", "demo ask".

tools.name: launch_campaign
tools.title: Launch a campaign (creates a draft)
tools.description: Creates a DRAFT campaign in the connected crm.care workspace from a brief. Returns the campaign id and workspace URL. Honest scope: this creates the brief-carrying draft — content generation, review, and publishing to the marketing platform happen in the workspace (or via further granted authority). The action is logged in the Operator's history and is undoable. Requires a workspace API token; called without one it returns instructions for minting it rather than an error.

objective.description: What it should achieve — ideally with a number.

keyMessage.description: The one thing the audience should believe afterwards.

context.description: Anything else the strategist should know.

idempotency_key.description: Optional. Repeat the call with the same key and the same inputs and it returns the campaign it already created instead of creating a second one. Honoured for 24 hours.

tools.name: list_campaigns
tools.title: List campaigns
tools.description: Lists campaigns in the connected workspace: id, name, status, recorded influenced pipeline and spend. Use before get_campaign_status when you don't have an id. Requires a workspace API token.

tools.name: get_campaign_status
tools.title: Get campaign status
tools.description: Returns one campaign's full status: lifecycle state, content counts (emails, social posts, assets, calendar items), CRM sync state, and recorded performance figures. Requires a workspace API token.

tools.name: get_goal_pnl
tools.title: Get goal P&L
tools.description: Returns the workspace's goals with their live P&L rollups: target pipeline vs influenced, budget vs spend, ROI, pacing health (Ahead / On track / Behind / At risk) and days left. The number an agent should check before proposing more campaigns. Requires a workspace API token.

tools.name: export_campaign_spec
tools.title: Export a campaign as a spec
tools.description: Returns one campaign as a crm.care campaign spec (campaign/0.1): the brief, channels, plan, segments, emails, social posts, calendar and gated assets as a portable YAML document. Import it into another workspace with import_campaign_spec, or keep it in version control. Requires a workspace API token.

format.description: Text format of the reply (default yaml).

annotations.title: Export a campaign as a spec

tools.name: import_campaign_spec
tools.title: Import a campaign spec (creates a draft)
tools.description: Creates a DRAFT campaign, with its content, from a crm.care campaign spec (campaign/0.1) — YAML or JSON, as a string or an object. Validates first and answers with every problem at once; nothing is published or sent. Returns the campaign id and workspace URL. Pass idempotency_key to make a retry a no-op. Requires a workspace API token.

spec.description: The spec, as YAML or JSON text, or as an object. Schema: https://crm.care/api/v1/campaign-spec/schema

idempotency_key.description: Optional. Repeat the call with the same key and the same spec and it returns the campaign it already created. Honoured for 24 hours.

annotations.title: Import a campaign spec (creates a draft)

tools.name: plan_campaign
tools.title: Plan a campaign against the connected platforms
tools.description: The plan against the connected platforms: what publishing a campaign would create, update or leave alone in the marketing platform and the CRM — per email, per segment, the nurture program, the CRM campaign — with why, and the consent each step needs. Pass id for a campaign in the workspace, or spec (YAML/JSON text or an object) for one not yet imported. Reads only; no platform call; nothing happens. Requires a workspace API token.

spec.description: A campaign spec, as YAML or JSON text, or an object.

annotations.title: Plan a campaign against the connected platforms
